# Stitch Hospitality

> Stitch Hospitality provides interim, fractional, and project-based leadership for hotels across California, Arizona, and Nevada, covering general management and operations, sales, marketing and commercial, and catering and events.

Stitch is led by a sitting general manager of a Forbes Five-Star hotel with more than 25 years in luxury hotels and resorts, from group and national sales with Four Seasons, Waldorf Astoria, and Hyatt to full-property general management. Detailed credentials are shared privately on request.

Stitch works with independent, boutique, luxury, and full-service hotels, and with the owners and management companies behind them.

## Engagement models

- **Interim & Task Force:** Hands-on leadership during a vacancy, leave, opening, or management transition. One-month minimum, typically 30 to 90 days.
- **Fractional Leadership:** A defined, recurring commitment of onsite and remote executive time on a monthly retainer, with scope agreed together.
- **Focused Projects:** A specific challenge with defined deliverables and milestones, such as an operations assessment, a sales and catering reset, opening readiness, or an ownership-reporting rhythm.

## Leadership roles covered

- General Management & Operations: General Manager, Hotel Manager / Assistant GM, Director of Operations
- Sales, Marketing & Commercial: Director of Sales & Marketing, Director of Sales, Commercial Director
- Catering & Events: Director of Catering, Director of Catering & Events, Director of Event Sales

## Service area

California, Arizona, and Nevada, including the Bay Area, Southern California, Phoenix, Scottsdale, and Las Vegas. Onsite presence and travel are agreed around each assignment.

## FAQ

- **What is interim hotel leadership?** An experienced leader steps into a vacant or transitioning role, such as general manager, director of sales and marketing, or catering leadership, and runs it hands-on while the permanent solution takes shape. Stitch interim assignments have a one-month minimum and typically run 30 to 90 days.
- **How does fractional hotel leadership work?** A recurring commitment of onsite and remote executive time on a monthly retainer, with priorities, authority, and reporting agreed up front. It suits hotels that need senior attention without a full-time hire.
- **How does an engagement start?** With a confidential conversation about the property, the leadership need, and timing. Scope, authority, measures, and the working rhythm are agreed before the work begins.

## Operator resources

- [The GM Ownership Report OS](https://www.stitchhospitality.com/ownership-report): an ownership-reporting playbook, 8-tab Excel workbook, Word report template, and prompt library designed for the USALI 12th Revised Edition, effective January 1, 2026. $29 for the PDF Playbook; $99 for the Full OS (introductory pricing). Files are owned outright, with no subscription.
- [HotelComply](https://hotelcomply.com): privacy documentation for hotels. A separate Stitch Hospitality product on its own website.
